description.en: <html>Causes you to inflict <r name="var0"/> damage every 2 seconds for 10 seconds when you deal a critical strike with Fire Arrow, Meteor, and Meteoroid.</html>

<html>Causes Meteor or Meteoroid to apply the Incineration effect which increases the damage dealt by Meteor and Meteoroid by 10% and the mana cost of Meteor or Meteoroid by <r name="var0"/>%. Effect can stack up to 10 times. Casting a different spell cancels all stacks of the Incineration effect.</html>
<html>Grants a <r name="var0"/>% chance to decrease the cast time of your next Fire spell by 100% when you deal a critical strike with Fire Arrow.</html>
<html>Increases your Intelligence by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>
<html>Increases the damage dealt by your Fire spells by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>

<html>Increases your resistance to Fire, Frost, and Lightning spells by <r name="var3"/> and grants a <r name="var2"/>% chance to inflict <r name = "var0"/> to <r name = "var1"/> damage to an enemy after they attack you.</html>

<html>Summons an invisible trap for 2 minutes. Inflicts <r name = "var0"/> damage to all enemies within a 10 yard radius when an enemy enters the area. Only 1 trap can be active at a time. Cannot be used in combat.</html>
<html>Grants a <r name="var0"/>% chance to restore 3% of your maximum mana when you take Fire damage.</html>
Grants a 56% chance to reset the cooldown durations on your Fire spells by 100% when you receive a critical strike from a Fire spell.

<html>Decreases your healing done by 50%. Increases the magic damage dealt by all of your party members by 5% for 10 seconds when you cast a magic spell. Can be removed by casting Aura of Potency again. Cannot be used while your Aura of Fortitude effect is active.</html>

<html>Decreases your healing done by 50%. Increases the magic damage dealt by all of your party members by 10% for 10 seconds when you cast a magic spell. Can be removed by casting Aura of Potency again. Cannot be used while your Aura of Fortitude effect is active.</html>

<html>Increases your Perception by <r name="var0"/>%.</html>

Increases the damage absorbed by the Stone Barrier and Stone Wall effect by 40%.
Increases the damage absorbed by the Stone Barrier and Stone Wall effect by 60%.
<html>Throws a fiery arrow that inflicts <r name = "var0"/> damage.</html>

Casting a spell or running out of mana will cancel the Mana Shield effect.</html>
<html>Decreases your damage taken by <r name="var0"/>% for each Fire Force point stored.</html>

<html>Applies 1 stack of the Playing with Fire effect when you do not deal a critical strike with Fire Arrow, Meteor, or Meteoroid which increases the critical strike damage dealt by your next Fire Arrow, Meteor, or Meteoroid by 10%. Effect can stack up to 3 times. Cancels up to 3 stacks of the Playing with Fire effect or applies 1 stack of the Burnt by Fire effect when you deal a critical strike with Fire Arrow, Meteor, or Meteoroid which decreases the critical strike damage dealt by your next Fire Arrow, Meteor, or Meteoroid by 10%.</html>

<html>Applies 1 stack of the Playing with Fire effect when you do not deal a critical strike with Fire Arrow, Meteor, or Meteoroid which increases the critical strike damage dealt by your next Fire Arrow, Meteor, or Meteoroid by 10%. <html>Applies 1 stack of the Playing with Fire effect when you do not deal a critical strike with Fire Arrow, Meteor, or Meteoroid which increases the critical strike damage dealt by your next Fire Arrow, Meteor, or Meteoroid by 10%.
